hobbies.name: Chess
hobbies.description: Davit is an avid chess player rated ~1800 on Chess.com. He plays daily and participates in local club tournaments in Yerevan.

hobbies.name: Hiking
hobbies.description: Davit enjoys hiking in the Armenian mountains, especially around Mount Aragats and the Dilijan National Park. He aims to summit at least 5 peaks per year.

hobbies.name: Photography
hobbies.description: Amateur landscape and street photographer. Davit shoots on a Sony Alpha mirrorless camera and shares his work on Instagram.

hobbies.name: Reading
hobbies.description: Reads ~30 books per year, primarily technical books, sci-fi, and Armenian literature. Current favourites: 'The Pragmatic Programmer', 'Dune', and 'The Master and Margarita'.

hobbies.name: Coffee
hobbies.description: Passionate about specialty coffee. Davit is a home barista who roasts his own beans and experiments with various brewing methods.
